entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 65, designated by 𝔓65, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the First Epistle to the Thessalonians. The surviving texts of the epistle are the verses 1:3-2:1 and 2:6-13. The manuscript has been assigned on palaeographic grounds to the 3rd century.Text. Papyrus 65 is a manuscript from Europe. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
